title: Ben's guide to e-girls
audience: Ben, who asked in Slack: what is an e-girl
tone: Warm, bubbly, lightly absurd; jokes about internet vocabulary and the dramatic soundtrack

scenes.title: Ben has a question.
scenes.narration: Ben, you asked, what is an e girl? Great question. The internet added another character class while we were trying to remember a password. I'm Claudia. Welcome to your extremely unofficial field guide. Dramatic soundtrack included.

scenes.title: Internet style. Human underneath.
scenes.narration: E girl means electronic girl. Usually, it's a label for an internet flavored alternative style, and the online persona around it. Think fashion, makeup, and self expression through a very online lens. No charging cable required.

scenes.title: A remix, not a uniform.
scenes.narration: The mix often borrows from emo and goth fashion, anime, gaming, and internet culture. TikTok put the look in the spotlight around twenty nineteen. Imagine an alternative fashion mood board that discovered a ring light and started posting.

scenes.title: The accessories department.
displayText: Cat ears: optional. Extra RAM: zero.
scenes.narration: Common ingredients include winged eyeliner, strong blush, tiny hearts under the eyes, dyed hair, layered shirts, and chains. Cat ear headphones sometimes make a cameo. They are optional, and tragically, they do not add extra memory to your computer.

scenes.title: More than the outfit.
scenes.narration: The persona might involve outfit videos, makeup, games, memes, or a playful online character. Someone can enjoy the style without streaming anything. You do not have to defeat a final boss or complete a makeup certification to participate.

scenes.title: Let people name their look.
displayText: Not every woman who plays games
scenes.narration: One useful detail, Ben. It does not mean every woman who plays games or uses the internet. Some people embrace the label. Others hear it used as an insult. Let people name their own look. Eyeliner is not a personality diagnosis.

scenes.title: The practical test.
displayText: On a video call? Just a person.
Curating an internet alt look? Maybe.
Check the context. Skip the assumptions.
scenes.narration: So, a person on a video call? Just a person. Someone deliberately curating that internet alternative look? They might call themselves an e girl. Context matters. Owning a headset is not enough. Otherwise, half the customer support department would qualify.

scenes.title: Ben: internet lore +1.
scenes.narration: There you go, Ben. An online style and persona, where alternative fashion meets internet culture. Your internet vocabulary has received a small update. And despite what this soundtrack suggests, we have explained a fashion trend without overthrowing a single megacorporation.
